subtitle: Cinematic Dominion — Personal Premiere, Local Poster Gallery & Full-Site Visual Redesign
changes: Added a cinematic feature premiere that highlights one personal saved local video with its best available poster, favorite or playback-resume context.
Added a filmstrip of up to four additional saved titles; play, resume, and shuffle use the original Video Vault playback event.
Reused small stills from personal GIF/video cover artwork for the featured title, while never auto-playing large cover media in the new hero.
Redesigned the header, global landing panel, Command Center, Overdrive destinations, cards, and iPhone dock with an immersive violet/cyan/gold treatment.
Added optional Calm/Cinematic appearance control persisted locally; supports reduced-motion and compact layouts without changing saved personal media.
Existing videos, local OPFS/IndexedDB, collections, favorites, custom animated covers, background art, icon editor, offline rollback and all 18 studios are preserved.
